div.l: And who so wol / my Iugemēnt withseye
Shal paye al that we spendyn / bi the weye
And if that ye vouche saaf / that it be so
Telle me a noone / withouten · wordys moo
And I wol erly / shape me therfore
This thyng was graıı̄untyd / and our othis swore
With wel glad herte / and preyden hym also
That he wolde vouche safe / it for to doo
And that he wolde / be / our gouernoure
And of our talis / Iugis and reportoure
And set a sopeer / at a certeyn prys
And we wol rewlyd be / at his devys
In hie and lowe / and thus bi oon assent
We beth accorded / to the Iugement
And thervpon · / the wyn· was fet anoon ·
We dronkyn / and to reste wenten eủerychoon ·
With oute any / lengere taryinge
A morwe whan the day / gan to sprynge
Vp roos our host / and was our alderys cok
And gadered vs to gidre / in a flok
And forth we redyn · / lytil more than apaas
Vn to the watteryng / of seynt Thomas
And ther our host / bi gan his arreste
And seyde lordys / herkenyth if ye leste
Ye wetyn yowr forward / and your record
Yif evensong / and morwe song accord
Lat se who shal telle / the ferste tale
As euer mot I drynke / wyn or ale
Who so is rebell / to my Iugement
Shal paye for all that / bi the wey is spent
Now draweth cutt / er we ferther twynne
He that hath the shortest / shal begynne
Syr knyht qd he / my mayster and my lord
